description: Make White Cliffs width checks follow an inflated boat through carried containers instead of allowing container shrinkage.

<ROUTINE WHITE-CLIFFS-FUNCTION (RARG)

		       <SETG DEFLATE <>>)

replacements.new:
"SUBTITLE OLD MAN RIVER, THAT OLD MAN RIVER..."

<ROUTINE ROUTE-MASTERY-CARRIED? (OBJ "AUX" HOLDER)
    <SET HOLDER <LOC .OBJ>>
    <REPEAT ()
        <COND (<NOT .HOLDER> <RFALSE>)
              (<EQUAL? .HOLDER ,WINNER> <RTRUE>)
              (<EQUAL? .HOLDER ,HERE ,ROOMS> <RFALSE>)>
        <SET HOLDER <LOC .HOLDER>>>>

<ROUTINE WHITE-CLIFFS-FUNCTION (RARG)
	 <COND (<EQUAL? .RARG ,M-END>
		<COND (<ROUTE-MASTERY-CARRIED? ,INFLATED-BOAT>
		       <SETG DEFLATE <>>)
	       	      (T
